name: Teen Fellows
what_you_do: A 15 month program about architecture and design. Fellows do a six week summer session, take fall and spring terms, and finish with a paid second-summer internship or more college classes.
who_can_apply: Students going into 10th, 11th or 12th grade at a high school in Chicago or nearby who can do the whole program. Students from farther away can apply. They are picked based on need and on whether they have similar programs near home.
pay_detail: Free to join. Fellows earn a stipend (amount not stated) and may get a paid internship in the last summer (rate not stated).
deadline_text: Summer 2027 to Summer 2028 applications are open until Mar 31, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Interviews for some applicants Apr 12 to May 5, 2027. Decisions emailed May 14, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on the Teen Fellows page. Some applicants are picked for an interview. Questions: teens@architecture.org.
notes: Open as of Nov 3, 2026. The internship is paid, so ask the program about Illinois working papers for under 16. The page does not say. City Colleges tuition aid is only for Chicago residents. Dual credit is for CPS students.
